title.value: Personality Detection of Applicants And Employees Using K-mode Algorithm And Ocean Model
title.justification: The title is taken from the provided document information, which clearly states the main focus of the paper.
title.quote: Personality Detection of Applicants And Employees Using K-mode Algorithm And Ocean Model

extractions.description: The paper discusses a model for detecting personality types of applicants and employees using the K-mode algorithm and the OCEAN model to enhance recruitment and employee management processes. It emphasizes analyzing video interviews and survey responses to improve selection processes in human resources by predicting personality traits and assessing individual work performance.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses primarily on improving recruitment and employee management processes using AI, without a direct relation to climate or ecological sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The company can hire or pick the best candidate for the desired job description by grouping applicants based on the necessary personality preferences.

applications.value: Improvement of recruitment processes in human resources departments through AI-driven personality detection.
applications.justification: This application is identified as the central theme of the paper, emphasizing the use of algorithms to enhance hiring processes.
applications.quote: Here, the K-Modes clustering method is used to predict employee well-being, including job pressure, the working environment, and relationships with peers, utilizing the OCEAN Model and the CNN algorithm in the AVI-AI administrative system.
